notes.title: 🛠️ Beyond the Ice Palace 2 – Latest Patch Update Now Live! 🛠️
notes.notes:
Adventurers, your journey through the cursed kingdom just got even smoother! Our latest patch update is now live, bringing key fixes, improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements to ensure an even better gameplay experience.

🛡️ [b]Key Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- Improved transitioning from ring to ring
- Improved ledge grabbing
- Balanced the Paige of the Capital boss fight
- Reduced Screen shake
- Balanced stamina upgrade

📜 [b]Gameplay & UI Improvements:[/b]
- Added total money banked UI when reaching a Spectral Circle
- Fixed an issue where music would not loop correctly
- Fixed an issue where insect enemies would sometimes not attack
- Fixed an issue where a wall did not have collision
- Fixed an issue where players could fall through the map
- Fixed an issue with the sky
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck if they quit the game after defeating but before executing the Paige of the Capital
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck if they defeated the Paige of the Capital after being grabbed
- Fixed an issue where players could not execute the Paige of the Swamp correctly
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck after executing the Paige of the Swamp

🔧 [b]Additional Fixes & Optimisations:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where a potion could drop in an unreachable location
- Fixed multiple text issues in multiple languages
- Fixed multiple missing Translations
- Fixed an issue where the game could appear blurry when using the Rage ability
- Fixed an issue where the game would not display correctly on boot in ultrawide resolution
- Fixed an issue where character upgrades were incorrectly carried over to a new game
- Fixed an issue where a chest was not able to be reached
- Fixed an issue where the player could stop taking damage

We appreciate your feedback and support as while we've been hard at work enhancing Beyond the Ice Palace 2.

🔥 Continue Your Adventure Now!

Jump back in and experience the improvements first-hand—your throne awaits!

notes.title: Beyond the Ice Palace 2 - OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[h2]Behold, the Cursed King has returned!
[/h2]

After an unprecedented 37-year wait, gaming history has been made with the release of [b][i]Beyond The Ice Palace 2[/i][/b], shattering records as the longest gap between an original game and its sequel. When the first [b][i]Beyond The Ice Palace[/i][/b] captivated players on platforms like Amiga, Commodore 64, and ZX Spectrum in 1988, few could have imagined that fans would wait nearly four decades for a continuation of the beloved fantasy action platformer.

[previewyoutube=duIPJVJrPBU;full][/previewyoutube]

Developed by Storybird Studio and co-published by PQube and PixelHeart, Beyond the Ice Palace 2 embraces the best of classic platforming while introducing fresh gameplay elements. PixelHeart, known for reviving forgotten classics, ensures the game honours its legacy while delivering a modern experience.

notes.title: I’m not sure what’s weirder: that someone made a sequel to a completely forgettable 37-year-old game I played as a kid, or that it was actually worth the wait
notes.notes: I do love it when a retro game makes an unexpected comeback, and games don't get much more retro than Beyond the Ice Palace. It's been decades since the game—so old one version of it was sold on tape—made its debut, and now a sequel's appeared, boldly calling itself Beyond the Ice Palace 2 as if anyone outside of the development team or people who think 64KB is plenty of RAM still remember the first one ever existed... Read more.

notes.title: Beyond The Ice Palace 2 Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We are very excited to announce that 'Beyond the Ice Palace 2' is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One in 2024! 
[b]
See Our Announcement Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=T5muk-OkOWE;full][/previewyoutube]

Embark on a journey of vengeance and redemption as the 'Cursed King,' reclaiming your rightful throne in this action platformer. Wield the chains that once imprisoned you, now transformed into powerful weapons, to vanquish foes, solve puzzles and navigate the treacherous terrain of your shattered kingdom. 
 
[b]Sequel to a Commodore 64 Classic:[/b] Beyond The Ice Palace returns to home consoles with a revival of a classic, 36 years after the original release!

[b]Wield The Chains That Once Imprisoned You:[/b] Utilise varied 'whip' mechanics, from entwining enemies in combat to skilfully attaching to rings, enabling seamless traversal and satisfying platforming across intricately designed levels. 

[b]Banish Colossal Demons From Your Lands: [/b]Test your strategic finesse and precise timing in intense battles that demand skilful manoeuvring to overcome tough gigantic foes.

[b]A Dark, Harrowing Story:[/b] Arise from the forsaken crypts where you were abandoned for death and plunge into the haunting saga of the 'Cursed King'. Embark on a perilous quest of vengeance to retrieve the shattered remnants of celestial arrows to break your curse and wreak havoc on your enemies. 

[b]Discover Hidden Areas and Reclaim Your Kingdom's Treasures: [/b]Uncover the secrets of Beyond The Ice Palace 2 with hidden areas, puzzles and valuable items found amongst the lands.

[b]Upgrade the Cursed King: [/b]Uncover elusive "power crystals" and harness their essence to strategically enhance your abilities, gaining an edge on the looming challenges ahead.

Coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S in 2024!
